div.div:
Notation: ◆── composition (the whole owns its parts) ─── association with multiplicities
──▷ generalization (TextPreview / ImagePreview are kinds of FilePreview) - - ▷ dependency («use», «reads», «creates»)
SortDirection and TypeFilter are the parameters of the variant operation (sort by name, filter by type);
SyncSnapshot remembers the state after the last synchronization so that CONFLICT (changed on both sides)
can be told apart from LOCAL_NEWER / REMOTE_NEWER.
